title: Journeyman Electrician — Commercial
description:
Halverson Electric is a union commercial electrical contractor (IBEW Local 110 signatory) serving the Twin Cities metro since 1978. Our current backlog includes a six-story medical office building, two K-12 remodels, and ongoing service work for property-management accounts.

We are hiring Journeyman Electricians for commercial new construction and tenant-improvement work.

What you'll do:
• Install, bend, and pull conduit (EMT, rigid, PVC) and wire per plans and the NEC
• Rough-in and trim branch circuits, feeders, panelboards, and lighting controls
• Terminate and label panels; build accurate panel schedules; torque terminations to spec
• Perform megger and continuity testing; troubleshoot faults on energized and de-energized systems following NFPA 70E and our lockout/tagout program
• Read one-lines, riser diagrams, and lighting plans in Bluebeam; keep redlines current for as-builts
• Direct 1–2 apprentices, verify their work, and sign off their OJT hours
• Coordinate daily with the foreman, GC superintendent, and other trades; call for inspections and walk them with the AHJ

Requirements:
• Current Minnesota Journeyman (Class A) electrician license
• Completed state-registered apprenticeship or equivalent hours (8,000)
• Working knowledge of the 2023 NEC as adopted in Minnesota; code-change class current
• OSHA 30 card; NFPA 70E arc-flash training current
• Able to lift 50 lbs, work from lifts and ladders, and pass a background check for school-site work
• Valid driver's license; own hand tools

Scale wage and full IBEW benefit package (pension, health, annuity) per the Local 110 inside agreement. Steady overtime available on the medical office project through Q2 2027.
